title: Odile and the Ledger
author: Mara Oyelaran
blurb: Lior Almeida, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
